meaning:
τελευτή, -ῆς, ἡ
(τελέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת, מָוֶת ;]
1. a finishing.
2. an end: τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, death (Hdt., Plat., al.): Mat.2:15.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
